reuse.why: Puts the check in linkBankSyncAccount, the shared link routine all five provider handlers already delegate to, using the existing db.first helper.

duplication.why: The uniqueness rule is written once; no provider handler repeats it.

placement.why: Guard sits at the top of the shared link routine in accounts/app.ts, before any bank, account or sync side effect.

scope.why: Only the guard and tests for the requested cases.

maintainability.why: Simple and central; extracting the query into a named assertion would read slightly better but it is easy to own as is.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All provider link handlers go through linkBankSyncAccount.

one_place.where: linkBankSyncAccount in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, used by the GoCardless, SimpleFIN, Pluggy.ai, Akahu and Enable Banking link handlers.
